about: src/lib/week_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this ref (the backend and the POS core run the same rule from madar-time week_start). The ref is a commit sha, not a tag, until the next madar-shared tag; then move it to that tag. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and lib/madar-time.test.ts runs lib/week.ts (WEEK_START, weekStartOf) and features/dawam/week.ts against it.
